messages:
sana_support: Hey team — escalation from ACME (acme-42). They say dashboard token total for a streaming session is ~12,100 but invoice shows ~15,700. Customer pasted a raw SSE transcript and claims client canceled mid-gen. Can someone check if partial/late finalize frames are being double-counted or dropped? request_id: rq_0a1b2c

acme_ops: Thanks — attaching the transcript we captured on the client side. We see reconnects and one `client_cancel` right after a partial chunk. They think the server sent a trailing finalize after reconnect.

acme_ops: ```
:connect
data: {"type":"delta","text":"Hello, welcome to ACME docs","tokens":7}
data: {"type":"delta","text":"\nHere are the steps...","tokens":12}
data: {"type":"progress","tokens":19}

# client disconnects here
:disconnect
# reconnect, server resends last chunk
data: {"type":"delta","text":"Here are the steps...","tokens":12}
data: {"type":"final","text":"Done","tokens":3}
data: [DONE]
```

eli_engineer: I dug into the session in the streaming ledger. The server emits intermediate token events to the in-memory session buffer and writes a commit when it receives an explicit finalize event or a session timeout. Two things look suspicious: (1) after the reconnect we get a duplicate delta for the same text (server re-streamed last window) and (2) the finalize event came after the client reconnect which caused the commit to include both the original deltas + the re-streamed deltas. That can lead to an over-count if we don't dedupe by chunk id.

eli_engineer: Quick repro notes if you want to simulate locally:
1) Start an SSE generation with chunking and set `--stream-window=50ms`.
2) Kill the client mid-stream (simulate network drop).
3) Reconnect immediately and replay last partial buffer from the server.
4) Ensure the server triggers a finalize after reconnect.

Command snippet:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-lite&session=acme-42\"
# cut connection after first few frames, then reconnect to see duplicate deltas
```

jonathan_billing: Billing notes: our canonical billing uses committed/session-final events to attribute tokens to invoices. However the ledger write path currently accepts additive deltas when a commit occurs; if the system receives duplicate delta events with no stable dedupe key (chunk id) we can end up writing the same token counts twice then commit them. That would cause an over-charge — matches ACME's invoice > dashboard.

jonathan_billing: From the ledger I pulled: session rq_0a1b2c shows token contributions [7,12,19,12,3] and a commit sum of 63 tokens but the dashboard aggregated by unique chunk fingerprint collapsed the repeated 12 into one and shows 51. Scaling that to their whole session aligns roughly with the 2.6k token delta on the invoice.

eli_engineer: Action plan:
- Short term: issue a manual credit for the delta (SUP-9876). I've drafted the credit amount estimate to refund 2,600 tokens worth of charges.
- Medium: add chunk-id dedupe for in-flight delta writes (engine change). PR and rollout tracked in ENG-STREAM-214.
- Monitoring: add a Metric (streaming.dedup.events) + alert when dedup rate > 0.5% per host.

sana_support: Can we confirm the customer sees the credit? Jonathan, please confirm the exact refund amount and billing ticket.

jonathan_billing: Confirmed — created billing ticket BILL-4551 and credited acme-42 for 2,600 tokens ($0.78). Notified ACME via email + updated the invoice comment.

acme_ops: Thanks — they replied "appreciate the fast response" and asked for a short explanation we can paste in our audit logs.

eli_engineer: Short explanation for audit: "Root cause: duplicate delta frames emitted during client reconnect were written to the billing ledger because delta events lacked a stable chunk dedupe identifier. Resolution: manual credit issued; server will gain chunk-id deduplication to prevent recurrence."

replay-bot: runbook check: STREAMING-DEDUP-RUNBOOK v1.2 executed. Recommended postmortem: 2-week follow-up to verify dedupe rollout.

sana_support: Marking this thread resolved for support. Eli to own ENG task ENG-STREAM-214, Jonathan to close BILL-4551 after verification next invoice. acme_ops please confirm when you see the credit on your account. :thumbsup:

acme_ops: Confirmed — credit visible. Closing from our side. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
